The redrafts were written by separate claude-fable-5 sessions that sat on no jury.

notes: objective-taught: The objective is to tell living things from things that have NEVER BEEN ALIVE, but the lesson only teaches alive vs not alive and never introduces 'never been alive' (or 'dead'). Its own non-living example is a table ('Una mesa no está viva'), and tables and chairs (🪑 in items) are typically wooden, i.e. made from something that WAS alive, so the examples blur the very distinction the objective names (NC Y2: living, dead, never been alive). Use clearly never-alive examples (stone, metal spoon, plastic toy) or retitle the objective.
